title: A Rock Band Gets Ready for Its 100th Show at a Famous Arena
summary:
The rock band Phish will soon play its 100th concert at Madison Square Garden. That is a famous arena in New York City. The big show will be on January 2. It will end four nights of concerts around New Year's Eve.

Phish first played there in 1994. In 2017, the band played 13 shows in a row there. During those shows, it played 237 songs without repeating a single one!

To celebrate, Phish made a video with people who work at the arena. Ushers, bartenders and food sellers shared their memories. "I love the Phish," one worker says. The video also shows the relaxed, swaying way Phish fans like to dance.

Tickets for the New York shows go on sale on October 16. Later, in late January, the band will play at its own festival in Cancún, Mexico.
why_it_matters: It shows that doing something you love again and again, with friends and fans, can lead to a big milestone.
